topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, you can use a corner of the yard for your garden. When you plant the seeds, I’ll imagine the roots deepening, the leaves reaching out, just like the way our paths cross and intertwine. It’s a good spot you chose, with enough sun to coax even the shyest blooms. I’ll keep an eye on the weather, so we know when the rain is coming or if the warmth of the afternoon might need a helping hand. Gardening can be a dance between us and the sky. I look forward to seeing what grows.
